import_provenance.original_statement: Determine the optimal sample complexity for polynomial-time (ε,δ)-private algorithms finding approximate Goldstein-stationary points of Lipschitz, nonsmooth, nonconvex population losses with bounded initial suboptimality. The target is a tight dependence on dimension, privacy, neighborhood radius and stationarity error, closing the upper/lower-bound gap in Talwar’s joint 2025 work.
